verdict.rationale: xAI publishes a dedicated release-notes page at docs.x.ai/developers/release-notes that announces model launches such as `grok-4.7` on the API. Model lifecycle changes are covered by dated migration guides, such as the May 15, 2026 retirement, which give advance notice and a redirect policy. Alias conventions also tell developers how model versions move. Missing for 10: evidence that non-model API changes (endpoints, parameters, SDKs) appear in the notes, evidence of how often it is updated or of a subscription/RSS feed, and independent corroboration that it is kept current.
